declarations: The information furnished in the online application for the Academic Year 2026-2027 is true and correct, and nothing has been concealed or withheld.
The institution is functioning at the location approved by the Council and has not shifted to any other location.

A valid Occupancy Certificate / Completion Certificate / Building Licence / Form D, a valid Structural Stability Certificate where required, and a valid Fire Safety Certificate issued by the competent authorities have been uploaded on the portal.
All the programmes of the institution are conducted on one campus at the approved location and no programme is run at any other premises.
The institution has a regular Principal who possesses the qualifications and experience prescribed by the Council.
The institution fulfils the faculty norms and the faculty to student ratio prescribed by the Council for every approved programme.
The faculty data uploaded on the portal is true, and every faculty member shown is on the rolls of this institution only.
The institution does not retain the original degree certificates or other original documents of any faculty member or student.
The land of the institution, as given in the land table below, is contiguous and undisputed, and is owned by the Trust .
The land area and the built-up area given in this affidavit and in the online application are true and match the approved building plan.
Salaries are paid to faculty and staff as per the prescribed pay scales through bank transfer, with deductions towards provident fund and tax at source.
The student data of the previous academic years furnished on the portal is true and complete.
All fees and payments are collected and made only through digital modes, and no capitation fee is charged.
The audited statement of accounts of the Trust / Society / Company for the previous financial year has been uploaded on the portal.
No student is admitted beyond the intake approved by the Council for each programme.
The institution follows the provisions of Appendix 16/17 of the Approval Process Handbook and the Council's (Grant of Approval for Technical Institutions) Regulation Regulations, 2021.
The institution publishes the Mandatory Disclosure on its website as per Appendix 6 and keeps it up to date.
If any information given in this affidavit or in the online application is found to be false, the Council may take civil and/or criminal action against the deponent and the institution.
The following committees are constituted and functioning in the institution: Anti-Ragging Committee Anti-Ragging Squad Grievance Redressal Committee Internal Complaints Committee Committee for SC/ST
The deficiencies noted in the previous letter of Extension of Approval have been complied with within the period allowed.
There is no change in the name, location, management or Trust / Society / Company of the institution without the approval of the Council.
The faculty and staff data on the portal has been entered and checked by the Head of the Institution and is true.
The enrolment of students for the previous academic year has been uploaded on the portal within the prescribed date.
The institution has not been debarred by the Council or by the affiliating University in the previous academic year.
